name: news-silent-case
label: Silent case story (text on stock, no VO)
description: From N8 (@straits_times x SPF, 3.9k likes): a one-line loss hook, 5-7 text-on-B-roll cards of 4-6 s with one sentence each, a stat counter, a bold-verb checklist held 6-8 s, partner logos. Music is the voice.

_needs_feature.text_per_broll: a text card per B-roll item from beat.text (box style, bottom-left third), replacing captions
_needs_feature.crossfade: real dissolves between B-roll (dip is a brightness pulse, not a crossfade)
_needs_feature.stat_counter_beat: motion stat-counter in the accent colour (#FFD54F) with a one-line source
_needs_feature.checklist_card: a bold-verb list card (Check / Verify / Use / Avoid) held 6-8 s
